findings.text: follow-on: the guard that fires when an aggregation arm is missing is a manual verify action with no automated caller, so a later edit that drops the arms from the results JSON or the fragment reddens no test or gate.

follow-on: _aggregations execs a sibling evidence script by path, so renaming or moving srtj-name-signal-diagnosis-run.py breaks the aggregations action at runtime with a file-not-found rather than a message naming the dependency.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit; the single gained commit adds _diagnosis_module, _aggregations, _aggregation_rows and _verify to srtj-noul-polarity-run.py, appends the two arms to srtj-noul-polarity-results.json, deduplicates five element ids and appends the aggregation block to srtj-noul-polarity.html.
item_verdicts.done_when: the reviewed run's brief done-when names the re-measure figures; the manifest records the repaired gate, and I re-ran the verify action at head (review-verify-rerun.log EXIT=0) and against the pre-repair artifacts (review-verify-negative-control.log EXIT=1).
item_verdicts.goal: the gained commit is a repair of the blocking finding on the earlier review, to report the sign-aligned selected mean and the L2 logistic regression; docs/evidence/fragments/sn-review-through-jev/srtj-noul-polarity-results.json:1 now carries an aggregations block with both arms, and the fragment reports them at srtj-noul-polarity.html:103.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it names commit b1576711e, the aggregation arms with their calibration and validation values, the verify head log and the verify negative-control log, and records status complete.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the goal names three paths for the gained commit; git diff --name-only 106ce2f293a40a118c8643e215495c9be25e6944..b1576711e48723e0a3f347f6ba70de3a2ab20bf5 lists exactly those three and nothing else.

justifications.durability: srtj-noul-polarity-run.py:1587 defines _verify which raises when an arm is absent and is shown red against the pre-repair artifacts, but it is a manual argparse action that no test file or CI gate invokes, so the arms could be dropped from the artifacts again without reddening an automatic check.
justifications.evidence: I re-ran the named verify action at b1576711e (EXIT=0, both arms echoed with validation 0.7083 and 0.7359) and against the same action reading the 106ce2f29 artifacts (EXIT=1, RuntimeError naming the missing arms), so the recorded result reproduces and its negative control fires.
justifications.fit: the new functions follow the module's action idiom (srtj-noul-polarity-run.py:1679 selects _verify from the action choices) and the five element-id renames remove the duplicate ids that the assembled fragment carried, verified as 41 ids with no duplicate.
justifications.goal_fidelity: docs/evidence/fragments/sn-review-through-jev/srtj-noul-polarity-results.json:1 carries aggregations.selected_mean and aggregations.logistic_l2 each with calibration and validation AUC, so the two arms the finding said were missing are now reported.
justifications.reuse: srtj-noul-polarity-run.py:1185 imports the diagnosis script and _aggregations calls its own aggregation functions, so the aggregation is reused rather than copied; a search of imas_codex/ for an existing sign-aligned-mean or logistic aggregation owner found none.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --name-only 106ce2f293a40a118c8643e215495c9be25e6944..b1576711e48723e0a3f347f6ba70de3a2ab20bf5 lists only the three paths the goal names, and no file outside them changed.
